'''Khaleen Hentz''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was once a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] sent by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] as a mole in his spy network until she later turned to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and became the wife of Vos and the mother of [[Korto Vos|his child]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|I'm a thief. I can slip in and out of almost anywhere.|Khaleen|<ref name="Jedi: Count Dooku">''[[Jedi: Count Dooku]]''</ref>}}
Khaleen Hentz was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]]<ref name="Fact File 113" /> and a member of the [[Zealots of Psusan/Legends|Zealots of Psusan]],<ref name="CSWEZealots" /> a fast-growing<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> female-empowering<ref name="FarHorizons">''[[Far Horizons]]''</ref> cult.<ref name="CSWEZealots" /> She came to The ''[[The Wheel/Legends|Wheel]]'', a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Besh Gorgon system/Legends|Besh Gorgon system]], attracted to the idea of quick [[Currency/Legends|money]] and easily stealing from the tourists and [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] on the station.<ref name="Fact File 113" />

===Double agent===
{{Quote|Do you understand that Quinlan is a Jedi and, while he may have feelings, he can never allow himself "attachments"?''"<br />"''Do you think I give a spit what you Jedi allow or don't allow?!|Tholme and Khaleen Hentz|<ref name="Jedi: Count Dooku" />}}
[[File:HentzSecuraVos-Republic49.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Hentz on the Wheel.]]
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Dooku had her infiltrate the [[Quinlan Vos's Separatist spy network|undercover spy ring]] Vos was establishing for [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]]. To gain Quinlan's confidence, she was to pretend to love him, but as she fell in love with him legitimately, she stopped working for Dooku and became Quinlan's agent.

On The ''Wheel'', shortly after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], under direction of another of Dooku's agents, [[Tookarti]], Hentz stole a data chip from the crime lord [[Zenex]], containing the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] plans to attack [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Zenex ordered the mercenary [[Grakko]] to find and [[Death/Legends|kill]] her, but Grakko didn't succeed&mdash;Hentz killed him instead, by setting off one of his own [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. However, she soon ended up in a garbage pit&mdash;within it was a [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]]. She was barely saved by Vos and his former apprentice, [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], posing as a mechanic named Jaayza. She overheard their conversation about the disc and guessed that they were Jedi. In order to ensure that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] would be able to successfully defend Kamino, she was to give the data chip back to Zenex, under the watchful eye of Jedi Knights Vos and Aayla Secura. The plan appeared to be going well: Zenex promised he wouldn't kill her if she handed over the disc. Instead, he used his [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] pheromones to make her point a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] at her own head and kill ''herself''. Vos intervened and saved Hentz's life, whereas Secura killed Zenex by impaling him on her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

[[File:Khaleenquinlanspeeder.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Vos escapes with Hentz's help.]]

Hentz and Vos eventually fell in love, despite the protestations of Vos' [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Aayla and the disapproval of Vos' former master Tholme. During Vos' arrest and defection in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Clone Wars)|Battle of Brentaal IV]], Hentz took a [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] and helped him escape, knowing full well that she would do jail time again. Weeks later, Vos managed to infiltrate Dooku's inner circle, and Tholme released Hentz so she could serve as a go-between for Vos and himself.

While Vos continued his role as a double agent, Hentz was with him. She traveled with him to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during his quest to find and destroy the person he thought was the second [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. After Vos killed [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Viento]] under the false impression that he was the second Sith, Hentz was to pick him up after he fled the building, but was stopped by Dooku's [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Tol Skorr]].

[[File:Quinlankhaleen.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] kisses Hentz.]]

Hentz was soon forced to come with Vos to Viento's tomb, where he read his [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] corpse. As part of Vos' further quest, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] put out the word that Hentz wanted to hire the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sajé Tasha]] for a job. When Vos met Tasha, he confronted the bounty hunter and managed to draw the memories he sought from her mind. When her Anzati proboscises uncurled as she tried to feed upon his mind, Hentz interfered and hit her hard with a metal pole. Deciding that Tasha served her purpose, she decided to kill the Anzat. Tasha, angry that she had barely tasted the richness of Quinlan's mind, vowed vengeance on her.

Hentz traveled to [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] to set up Vos' meeting with [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]], whom he believed to be the second Sith. In a city cantina, she met Skorr and a few Anzati who were warned about her. Skorr told her to relay to Vos that he is allowed inside the base. He then called her a little bug and intimidated her by [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|Force choking]] her. After having his little fun, Skorr told Hentz that Vos didn't love her&mdash;he used her. While gasping for breath, Hentz murmured behind his back that Vos loved her.

Hentz then came back to the Republic base, trying to make "a [[Holocron/Legends|toy]]" work until Quinlan came in and told her that it was a holocron. She told him the plan and then spent a night with him.

[[File:KhaleenQuinlanKorto.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Hentz and Vos with their son.]]

Hentz was then captured by Skorr, who brought her to show Vos the truth of her mission. Hentz confessed that she was Dooku's double agent and pretended to love him but then fell in love with him for real. She pleaded with her love to look at her to see the truth. Despite urgings from Dooku and Bulq to kill her in order to complete his transition to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], Vos cupped Hentz's face in his hands, kissed her and then ignited his lightsaber to free her of her cuffs. But with [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and Anzati surrounding them, escape seemed impossible, until Tholme showed up. While the Jedi battled against their dark counterparts, Hentz killed every Anzati that tried to take her "[[Soup (Anzati)|soup]]." But when Quinlan fought against Sora Bulq and was getting closer to the dark side, Secura and Tholme joined to save him; Hentz thought that he was dying. When Vos killed Bulq, they managed to escape the base when the Republic began bombardment. Soon, Vos learned another secret Hentz was hiding&mdash;she was pregnant with his child. He decided that when the war was over, he would leave the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to be with her. He told her to take the [[Skorp-Ion]] to a safe place in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

===War's end===
While Vos was on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], he contacted Hentz. They thought that Kashyyyk may be a suitable place to raise their child.<ref name="SWR 81 HE1">[[Republic 81|''Republic'' 81]]</ref>

At the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], when Vos almost died on Kashyyyk, she was pregnant with his child and on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] with Jedi Masters Tholme and [[T'ra Saa/Legends|T'ra Saa]]. They evaded [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and traveled to Kashyyyk where they were hidden away by the [[Palsaang/Legends|Palsaang clan]]. Eight months after the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Hentz and her Jedi companions were reunited with Vos after she gave birth to their son, [[Korto Vos|Korto]].<ref name="Republic 83" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jan Duursema]] has said that Hentz's natural hair color is not purple.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/21901970|board=Literature|thread=The Official Jan Duursema Discussion Thread|user=Jan_Duuresema|date=2005-10-11|time=1:11 PM|archivedate=20200801145315|quote=Hmm, you don't think Khaleen's hair is NATURALLY purple, do you? :p}}</ref>

Jan Duursema stated the following about Quinlan and Khaleen's marriage:
:"''The Kiffar version of marriage is not a ceremony or a legal document. Kiffar 'marriage' is more of a state of mind or a state of being. Through Korto, Khaleen and Quin have an unbreakable connection--and a responsibility that transcends their own separate lives. If you create life, you nurture that life, whatever hardships lie ahead.''"<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.comicscommunity.com/boards/janduursema/?read=8561|text=Jan Duursema on the ComicsCommunity.com Message Boards|archivedate=20120324111528}}</ref>
